name: yf_insider_transactions
description:
Recent insider (officer and director) transactions in one stock from Yahoo Finance (yfinance insider_transactions).
Returns: {symbol, transactions: [{Shares, Value, URL, Text, Insider, Position, Transaction, Start Date, Ownership}]}, at most 100 rows.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (Yahoo ticker, e.g. AAPL, BRK-B, 7203.T).
Six-month buy/sell summary: yf_insider_purchases; Form 4 data from other sources: openbb_insider_trading, edgar_insider_transactions. No API key; data comes from Yahoo Finance through the yfinance library.
Example: {"symbol": "TSLA"}
